name: CITALOPRAM 20 MG 14 TABLETS
description: Citalopram 20 mg in a 14-tablet presentation is an antidepressant that belongs to the class of selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs). It is used to treat depression, panic disorder with or without agoraphobia, and obsessive-compulsive disorder. If symptoms persist, consult your doctor.
